title: Camera
drDigitalIntro:
Most laptops have a built-in camera at the very top of the screen.
• Look for a tiny dot or slit right above the display — that is it.
• It lets you take photos, record videos, and video call friends and family.
• When an app is using your camera, a small green or orange dot lights up near it so you always know when it is on.
• The activities in this course use a simulated camera, so your real camera never turns on.
drDigitalSuccess: That is the camera. You will use it in Unit 5, when we get to video calls.
drDigitalHint: Just look at the top edge of your own screen — that tiny dot is your camera. Click Continue when you're ready.
